headline: Glasgow closes Commonwealth Games after a 74-nation celebration
summary: Scotland hosts the final day of an 11-day event with more than 3,000 athletes, six integrated Para sports, and a streamlined venue plan after Australia withdrew as host.
script: Glasgow is showing how a major sporting event can use existing venues after Australia withdrew as host. Athletes from seventy-four nations are competing across ten sports and six Para sports. The practical payoff is less new construction and a more accessible event.
